title: I&P GN - SC&E – Analyst - Enterprise AI Value Strategy-EVS
summary:
The role involves applying AI tools to develop supply chain AI strategies, identify use cases, and create business and functional requirement documents.
Responsibilities include client engagement, data analysis, and supporting AI framework development.
Required skills encompass supply chain knowledge, AI concept familiarity, data synthesis, and strong communication, with preferred qualifications in advanced education and consulting experience.
qualifications_required: BASIC (REQUIRED) QUALIFICATIONS
1.5- 4years of experience (co-ops, or coursework) in supply chain management, operations, business analysis, or a related field.
Demonstrated functional understanding of at least one supply chain domain: Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Manufacturing, Procurement, Aftermarket, or Fulfillment / Logistics.
Familiarity with core AI concepts — including Agentic AI fundamentals, AI use case identification, and AI reference architecture at a conceptual level.
Experience writing or contributing to structured business documents such as process maps, requirements documents, or functional specifications — in an academic or professional setting.
Demonstrated ability to work with and synthesize data into clear, structured insights or recommendations.
Experience using AI tools (e.g., GenAI platforms, AI-assisted research or productivity tools) in an academic or professional context.
Strong written and verbal communication skills with an ability to explain complex concepts clearly to non-technical audiences.
jd_text:
You are curious about how artificial intelligence is reshaping the way global supply chains are designed, planned, and operated. You understand that the future of supply chain is not just about automation — it's about intelligent systems that learn, adapt, and collaborate. You bring a blend of functional supply chain knowledge and a growing fluency in enterprise AI concepts, and you're energized by the challenge of turning that combination into tangible value for clients. 
You're comfortable moving between structured analysis and open-ended problem-solving. You ask good questions, synthesize complex information quickly, and communicate your thinking clearly — whether you're mapping a demand-planning process, drafting a functional specification, or helping a client imagine what an AI-powered supply chain could look like. You're eager to grow, take direction well, and understand that great consulting outcomes are built on meticulous preparation and disciplined thinking. 
THE WORK 
Utilize relevant AI tools across all tasks and deliverable creation, including the creation of agents and other tools to help facilitate: 
Supply Chain AI Strategy & Use Case Development 
- Identify, assess, and prioritize AI use cases across supply chain domains — Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Manufacturing, Procurement, Aftermarket, and Fulfillment — by mapping current-state processes to AI-enabled future states. 
- Support the development of Business Requirements Documents (BRDs) and Functional Requirements Documents (FRDs) grounded in supply chain functional knowledge and client-specific context. 
- Contribute to AI reference architecture designs tailored for supply chain environments, illustrating how agentic AI components interact with enterprise data platforms, ERP systems, and planning tools. 
- Assist in crafting AI value cases and business cases that articulate ROI, risk, and transformation timelines for supply chain-specific AI initiatives. 
Client Engagement & Advisory Support 
- Support client workshops and discovery sessions by preparing materials, capturing requirements, and synthesizing stakeholder inputs across supply chain functions. 
- Prepare client-facing presentations, roadmaps, and strategy decks that translate AI and data concepts into accessible narratives for supply chain and operations leaders. 
- Apply Design Thinking principles to facilitate structured problem definition and solution ideation sessions with client teams. 
- Maintain and evolve the team's repository of supply chain AI frameworks, benchmarks, and industry case examples. 
Data & AI Foundations 
- Develop foundational fluency in enterprise data concepts — data products, data pipelines, and agentic AI hierarchies — as they apply to supply chain planning and execution systems. 
- Support data analysis tasks to surface insights from supply chain datasets (e.g., forecast accuracy, inventory performance, supplier scorecards) in service of client recommendations. 
- Explore and apply prompt engineering and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) techniques to build or enhance AI tools that support supply chain advisory workflows. 
- Complete assigned AI literacy and continuous-learning modules, contributing to a culture of applied innovation within the team.
BASIC (REQUIRED) QUALIFICATIONS 
- 1.5- 4years of experience (co-ops, or coursework) in supply chain management, operations, business analysis, or a related field. 
- Demonstrated functional understanding of at least one supply chain domain: Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Manufacturing, Procurement, Aftermarket, or Fulfillment / Logistics. 
- Familiarity with core AI concepts — including Agentic AI fundamentals, AI use case identification, and AI reference architecture at a conceptual level. 
- Experience writing or contributing to structured business documents such as process maps, requirements documents, or functional specifications — in an academic or professional setting. 
- Demonstrated ability to work with and synthesize data into clear, structured insights or recommendations. 
- Experience using AI tools (e.g., GenAI platforms, AI-assisted research or productivity tools) in an academic or professional context. 
- Strong written and verbal communication skills with an ability to explain complex concepts clearly to non-technical audiences. 
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS 
- MBA or Master's degree in Supply Chain, Business Analytics, Information Systems, or a related discipline. 
- Coursework, certifications, or self-directed learning in AI, machine learning, or data platforms (e.g., cloud certifications, AI/ML specializations). 
- Exposure to consulting environments through internships, case competitions, or strategy project work — with demonstrated ability to structure problems and communicate recommendations. 
- Familiarity with enterprise planning or ERP platforms (e.g., SAP IBP, o9, Kinaxis, Blue Yonder, Oracle SCM) in an academic or professional context. 
- Participation in supply chain case competitions, AI hackathons, or strategy projects with measurable outcomes. 
- Working knowledge of data visualization or analytics tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, Python, SQL) applied in a supply chain or operations context. 
- Understanding of Prompt Engineering or Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) techniques — even at a foundational or experimental level.

Exposure to, or techno-functional experience integrating, master data management, data migration, and inventory/warehouse processes with underlying SAP technology solutions.
Ability to support or lead client workshops, fit-gap analysis, documentation, and requirement gathering, scaled to level.

Deep domain expertise in SAP based projects across industries
jd_text:
Role Description: 
We are looking for SAP-skilled professionals to join Accenture's Smart Aftersales Service practice, focused on Spare Parts Planning & Logistics Management – a priority growth capability within our Global Network Aftersales organization, where SAP expertise is the primary hiring driver. 
In this role, you will work on service parts planning, warehouse and logistics execution, order fulfillment, and master data management for aftersales clients across asset-intensive industries. You will collaborate with leadership and peers to deliver best-practice SAP-based supply chain and logistics solutions and contribute to the development of new assets and offerings for our global COE. 
Focus will be on applying SAP EWM, SAP SD, and SAP MM to spare parts segmentation, inventory optimization, warehouse operations, and order-to-cash processes, alongside master data management (MDM) and data migration for the aftersales value chain. SAP Service Module experience is a strong plus. 
Key Responsibilities include: 
- Deliver and/or lead SAP EWM, SD, and MM workstreams addressing inbound/outbound logistics, warehouse structure design, inventory management, order-to-cash processes, pricing, billing, and customer service for our clients across the globe. 
- Drive spare parts planning activities: demand forecasting, parts segmentation, inventory optimization, and fulfillment & logistics execution. 
- Lead or support data migration and harmonization activities (e.g., LSMW, SAP BODS, or equivalent tools), ensuring clean master data and a seamless transition to SAP S/4HANA. 
- Lead or participate in workshops, blueprinting, and fit-gap analysis to align SAP solutions with client-specific spare parts and logistics processes; own delivery quality against client KPIs. 
- Interface with client teams to gather requirements, document business processes, and lead or support solution walkthroughs and demos. 
- Work closely with technical teams (ABAP, Basis, Integration) to support end-to-end solution delivery. 
- Contribute to business development / RFP responses and opportunity shaping to expand Spare Parts Planning & Logistics offerings. 
- Build reusable assets, accelerators, and frameworks for spare parts planning, inventory management, and logistics; mentor junior team members as applicable.
Preferred Experience 
- 3–10 years of experience in aftermarket / aftersales service operations, supply chain, or logistics, including exposure to SAP-based environments. 
- Hands-on experience in SAP SD and SAP EWM, gained through project delivery, support, or configuration work (SAP MM a plus; SAP Service Module experience a strong plus). 
- Exposure to, or techno-functional experience integrating, master data management, data migration, and inventory/warehouse processes with underlying SAP technology solutions. 
- Ability to support or lead client workshops, fit-gap analysis, documentation, and requirement gathering, scaled to level. 
- Experience contributing to business development, RFP responses, or opportunity shaping in a consulting context is a plus at the Consultant level. 
Your experience counts: 
- Deep domain expertise in SAP based projects across industries 
- At least partial consulting experience as a MUST 
- Experience in some of the industries like: Industrial, Med-Tech, Oil & Gas, Life Sciences etc 
- Exceptionally organized 
- Detail oriented 
- Strong communication skills 
- Proactive and able to work independently 
- Sensitivity and skill at working with different cultures and styles 
- A highly motivated self-starter 
- Engineering background with MBA preferred

Entity: - Accenture Strategy & Consulting 
Team: - Global Network - Data & AI 
Practice: - CMT – Software & Platforms 
Title: - 11 - Ind & Func AI Decision Science Analyst 
Job location: - Hyderabad/Bangalore 
About S&C - Global Network: - Accenture Global Network - Data & AI practice help our clients grow their business in entirely new ways. Analytics enables our clients to achieve high performance through insights from data - insights that inform better decisions and strengthen customer relationships. From strategy to execution, Accenture works with organizations to develop analytic capabilities - from accessing and reporting on data to predictive modelling - to outperform the competition 
About the Team: - 
The team is focused on driving Data & AI based solutions for SaaS and PaaS clients for Accenture. The team collaborates actively with onsite counterparts to help identify opportunities for growth as well as drives client deliveries from offshore. 
WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU? 
- As part of our Data & AI practice, you will join a worldwide network of smart and driven colleagues experienced in leading statistical tools, methods, and applications. From data to analytics and insights to actions, our forward-thinking consultants provide analytically informed, issue-based insights at scale to help our clients improve outcomes and achieve high performance. 
- Accenture will continually invest in your learning and growth. You'll work with experts in SaaS & PaaS and Accenture will support you in growing your own tech stack and certifications. 
- In Data & AI you will understands the importance of sound analytical decision-making, relationship of tasks to the overall project, and executes projects in the context of a business performance improvement initiative. 
What you would do in this role 
- Development and testing of AI algorithms and techniques, custom-tailored to effectively address and solve specific, complex business problems. 
- Manage large databases proficiently, conducting exploratory data analytics to derive valuable insights for stakeholders. 
- Track down and thoroughly investigate previous information related to a problem, asking probing questions to identify root causes. 
- Employ a systematic approach to problem-solving, exploring known avenues and asking insightful questions to unravel the core issues. 
- Work collaboratively with both internal teams and external consultants/managers to achieve project objectives. 
- Develop and manage data pipelines to streamline the flow of information for enhanced efficiency. 
- Demonstrate adaptability and flexibility in responding to changing project requirements. 
- Proactively seek and embrace continuous learning opportunities to stay updated with the industry trends and advancement.
Who are we looking for? 
- Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, engineering, data science, or a related field. 
- Experience working for large Software or Platform organizations. 
- Proven experience (2+ years) in working on AI projects and delivering successful outcomes. 
- Hands-On exposure to Generative AI frameworks (Azure Open AI, Vertex AI) and implementations & Strong knowledge of AI technologies, including Embedding, prompt engineering, natural language processing, computer vision, etc. 
- Hands on experience in building and deployment of Statistical Models/Machine Learning including Segmentation & predictive modelling, hypothesis testing, multivariate statistical analysis, time series techniques, and optimization. 
- Ability to work with large data sets and present findings / insights to key stakeholders; Data management using databases like SQL 
- Proficiency in statistical packages such as R, Python, Java, SQL, Spark, etc. 
- Knowledge in training large language models and fine-tuning for specific applications or domains. 
- Experience with cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud for deploying and scaling language models. 
- Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with a data-driven mindset. 
- Proficient in Excel, MS word, PowerPoint, etc.

Location: Gurgaon

Good to have skills: AI Refinery, LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, Crew AI, Spark, Cloud Platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), NLP, Computer Vision, Vector Databases, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), Function Calling, Tool Integration

Educational Qualification: Bachelor's or Master's degree (BE/BTech/MBA/MS) in Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, AI/ML, or related disciplines with an excellent academic record
Job Summary: 
As an AI Decision Science Analyst, you will lead the design, development, and deployment of sophisticated AI agents and multi-modal AI solutions that can autonomously execute complex business workflows. You will leverage cutting-edge Generative AI, Agentic AI frameworks, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations to create intelligent systems that can reason, plan, and act independently to solve complex business challenges across various industries. Your expertise will drive innovation in autonomous AI solutions and deliver transformative value for clients through intelligent agent orchestration and seamless system integrations.
Roles & Responsibilities: 
- Advanced Generative AI & Agentic System Development
- Design and implement sophisticated AI agents using frameworks like AI Refinery, LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, and custom agentic architectures
- Develop multi-agent systems that can collaborate, negotiate, and execute complex workflows autonomously
- Implement Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations for seamless communication between AI systems and external tools/APIs
- Build and deploy Generative AI applications with advanced reasoning, planning, and execution capabilities
- Leverage Advanced Data Science Techniques:
- Develop solutions using Computer Vision, Machine Learning, and Large Language Models (LLMs).
- Define data requirements, clean, aggregate, analyze, and interpret data while conducting data quality assessments.
- Develop and Implement AI Models:
- Build and deploy AI models and Generative AI applications.
- Train and fine-tune LLMs using large-scale datasets to optimize performance and accuracy.
- Evaluate model performance and implement iterative improvements.
- Solution Integration and Deployment:
- Collaborate to integrate AI solutions into end-to-end workflows, ensuring scalability.
- Utilize cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or GCP for model development and deployment.
- Innovation and Knowledge Sharing:
- Stay updated on advancements in AI and Data Science, exploring innovative techniques and frameworks.
- Document methodologies and findings for effective knowledge sharing.
Professional & Technical Skills: 
- Must To Have Skills: Expert proficiency in Generative AI, Agentic AI Systems, Model Context Protocol (MCP), LLMs, Multi-Agent Systems, Python, SQL, AI Agent Orchestration frameworks.
- Cloud & Infrastructure: AWS/Azure/GCP, Docker, Kubernetes, Spark, MLOps pipelines for agentic systems
- Specialized Knowledge: NLP, Computer Vision, Reinforcement Learning for agent training, Multi-modal AI systems
- Experience in developing and AI/ML models.

- The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in agentic AI systems with a proven track record of building autonomous AI solutions that can execute complex business workflows
- Strong understanding of AI safety, alignment, and governance principles for autonomous systems
- Experience with enterprise-grade AI agent deployments and production system management

ARE YOU READY to step into the New Era (NewRA) of AI-driven banking?
At Accenture Newra AI Hub, we are not just building technology, we are redefining how banking operates. Built to make a real difference, Newra reflects our belief that AI creates value only when it genuinely improves people’s lives.
You will work on advanced AI solutions that span the full spectrum of the bank -from core banking systems to customer experience- simplifying complexity, automating critical processes and delivering measurable results where they matter most.
Joining Newra means becoming part of a high-performing team of innovators at the beginning of a major reinvention. This is a space for people who approach AI with depth, discipline and purpose. You will collaborate across disciplines, develop future-proof skills, and help turn technology into real-world transformation.
As an AI Value Strategy Analyst, you’ll help turn AI ambition into measurable enterprise value, connecting strategy, investment decisions, delivery progress, and realized business outcomes. You’ll define the value framework, KPIs, dashboards, and governance mechanisms that show where AI is creating impact and where to scale next. You’ll work across business, technology, finance, operations, and delivery teams to make AI value visible, measurable, and continuously improved.
What you'll build

- Define and maintain value realization methodologies, KPIs, and measurement mechanisms across transformation and AI programs
- Track and monitor business benefits, financial impact, productivity gains, and operational outcomes across initiatives
- Build executive dashboards, reporting packs, and value tracking mechanisms for senior leadership and governance forums
- Develop business cases, investment justifications, and value articulation for AI use cases going live
- Connect technology investments to measurable business outcomes and operational impact
- Partner with business and technology stakeholders to prioritize initiatives based on strategic value, ROI, and execution feasibility

What we need
- Degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Engineering, or related field
- 2-3 years in strategy, transformation, PMO, or value management, ideally in a tech or financial services context
- Proven track record building ROI models, business cases, and value measurement frameworks
- Strong analytical skills, comfortable with financial modelling, KPI design, and executive-level reporting
- Excellent communicator, you translate complex data into clear narratives for senior stakeholders
- Hands-on with Power BI or Tableau for executive dashboards and portfolio reporting
- Understanding of AI and digital transformation, you know enough to ask the right questions and challenge assumptions
- Structured thinker; self-directed; thrives in ambiguity and cross-functional environments

- Experience in AI program governance or technology portfolio management
- Jira / Confluence for portfolio tracking; enterprise reporting platforms
- Exposure to benefits realization in regulated or financial services environments

title: Banking Reinvention & Value Engineering Analyst
summary:
The role involves analyzing and mapping current banking processes, designing AI-enabled future operating models, translating business problems into AI use cases, and building business cases with ROI models.
Required skills include strong structured thinking, communication, fluency in Greek and English, and a degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Engineering, or related fields.
Experience in consulting or banking and curiosity about AI are essential.
qualifications_required: Degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Engineering or a related field
1-2 years of experience in consulting, banking, transformation, business analysis or a comparable analytical role
Strong structured thinking; comfortable building and defending a quantitative model in Excel
Clear communicator who can turn analysis into a narrative a senior stakeholder will act on
Fluent written and spoken Greek and English
Curiosity about AI and the judgement to ask the right questions — you do not need to build models, but you do need to know what they can and cannot do
Comfortable with ambiguity and cross-functional environments
Exposure to banking domains, e.g. onboarding and KYC/KYB, lending, payments, custody
jd_text:
ARE YOU READY to decide what AI is actually worth building?
Every bank now has AI ambition. Very few can tell you which use case is worth funding, what the process has to look like for it to work, or whether the value ever arrived. That gap is the job.
As part of Accenture's AI & Data practice in Greece, you will join the team reinventing core banking domains with AI — working inside live engagements with systemic institutions, from client onboarding and KYB through lending, payments and servicing. You will sit between the business and the build: analysing how a process actually runs today, designing how it should run when an agent holds part of the decision, defining what gets built, and quantifying and tracking the value it delivers.
This is a role for people who want to understand the business, not only the technology.
What you'll do
- Analyse and map current-state banking processes — cycle time, effort, handoffs, rework, decision points — and distinguish the process as documented from the process as actually run
- Design future-state operating models for AI-enabled processes, including control points, exception paths and human-in-the-lead patterns
- Translate business problems into structured AI use cases, user stories and functional requirements, including acceptance criteria for probabilistic output
- Build business cases and ROI models: baselining, benefit quantification, phasing, sensitivity analysis
- Define KPIs and value tracking mechanisms, and build reporting that shows senior stakeholders where value is landing
- Contribute to discovery workshops with senior banking stakeholders — preparation, structured capture, synthesis and follow-up
- Act as a bridge between business and engineering teams through delivery
What we need
- Degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Engineering or a related field
- 1-2 years of experience in consulting, banking, transformation, business analysis or a comparable analytical role
- Strong structured thinking; comfortable building and defending a quantitative model in Excel
- Clear communicator who can turn analysis into a narrative a senior stakeholder will act on
- Fluent written and spoken Greek and English
- Curiosity about AI and the judgement to ask the right questions — you do not need to build models, but you do need to know what they can and cannot do
- Comfortable with ambiguity and cross-functional environments
Nice to have
- Exposure to banking domains, e.g. onboarding and KYC/KYB, lending, payments, custody
- Process mapping or business analysis experience
- Hands-on experience with GenAI tools, agents or prompt-based workflows
WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU?
- Competitive salary and benefits, including but not limited to: life/health insurance, performance based bonuses, monthly vouchers, company car (depending on management level), flexible work arrangements, employee share purchase plan, TEA Accenture, parental leave, paid overtime (if needed) and various corporate discounts
- Access to enterprise AI development tooling and the internal community building with it
- Continuous hard and soft skills training & development through global platforms & local academy, including cloud certification paths (Azure, GCP)
- Career coaching and mentorship to help you manage your career and develop professionally
- Ongoing strengths and skills based evaluation process
- Various opportunities to develop your career across a spectrum of clients, industries and projects
- Diverse and inclusive culture
- Corporate citizenship initiatives (access to volunteering opportunities, charity work etc.)
- Under our Brain Regain initiative, extra relocation benefits may apply
To learn more about Accenture, and how you will be challenged and inspired from Day 1, please visit our website accenture.com/gr-en/.

jd_text:
The Work 
We are Technology Strategy and Transformation. We help organizations reinvent technology by aligning business strategy, digital foundations, and AI-driven innovation to unlock measurable enterprise value.
As a Junior Technology Strategy & Transformation Consultant, you will work alongside senior client stakeholders and C-suite leaders to solve complex business and technology challenges. You will help shape technology strategies, design future-ready digital architectures, accelerate AI adoption, and deliver transformation programs that create sustainable business outcomes. Working in high-performance teams, you will combine strategic thinking with analytical rigor to help clients make critical technology investment decisions, modernize their technology landscape, strengthen their digital core, and realize value from transformation initiatives. From technology strategy and enterprise architecture to AI-enabled operating models and transformation delivery, you will play a key role in helping clients stay ahead in an increasingly digital world. 
- Team you will serve as a trusted advisor to our clients: In Technology Strategy & Transformation, we articulate a compelling technology vision with industry expertise and context. You will work with C-level executives, digital marketers and/or IT managers. With your ~100 direct colleagues you are at the heart of the change, developing value case and operating model with disruptive technologies in short to medium engagements. As a TS&T junior consultant you will be positioned at the crucial intersection of business, technology and the industry. We devise creative new digital strategies, implementation roadmaps and guide digital transformations based on trends, insights, data and our expertise. Our work always comes down to one thing: unlocking value and creating real, tangible impacts. 
- Processes you get energy from solving complex puzzles and working in teams: Our consultants in Digital Core are changing businesses every day using industry insights, knowledge and innovative ideas. Applying data-driven methods to analyze our clients’ strategic challenges, solving complex problems and helping them realize their business strategy through the right use of new technologies. Beside the work for our clients you will also be contributing to our practice and help the team grow and develop by e.g. participating and organizing events, creating points-of-view, and sharing your knowledge. 
- Technology Convey deep understanding of technology platforms and architecture at intersection of client's industry to (re)define the client’s technology stack. Realize value, advise, and execute medium to longer term technology transformations such as multi-year Cloud journeys with a clear industry focus, leveraging cloud partners and platforms to drive innovation, flexibility and agility across enterprise and build new businesses. 
- AI & Data: You will help clients unlock business value through AI and data. From shaping AI and data strategies to designing operating models and digital foundations, you will support organizations in becoming truly AI-driven enterprises. You will identify high-impact AI opportunities, help scale Generative AI and advanced analytics solutions, and embed data-driven decision-making into business processes and operations. By combining technology, business insight, and storytelling, you will help clients turn data into actionable intelligence and measurable outcomes.
With all our roles, there is some in-person time for collaboration, learning and building relationships with clients, peers, leaders, and communities. As an employer, we will be as flexible as possible to support your specific work/life needs.

In today’s world, business leaders want to rapidly and confidently reinvent to increase resilience, mitigate risk, and grow with sustainable value. That’s where Accenture Digital Core comes in. You will be a trusted partner to business leaders, working with a diverse team of experts to deliver successful tech-enabled transformation and new kinds of value for your clients. We hold ourselves accountable by providing the space for authenticity, growth, and equity for everyone.
AlixPartners has embraced a hybrid work model to provide flexibility and support our employees’ work-life integration. Our hybrid model combines a mix of in-person (at client site or AlixPartners office) and remote working. Travel is part of this position, but the frequency may vary based on client, team, and individual circumstances.
What you’ll do
An opportunity has become available for a Consultant (equivalent to an Associate in banking/Big 4 terms) with excellent financial analysis and written communication skills to join our Corporate Finance team in London. Over the course of the past 5 years, we have defined a clear pathway for consultants looking to build a career in Corporate Finance with no prior experience required. The role will at times be demanding, but with that will also come significant reward, and the ability to accelerate quickly. You will be working on complex, time-sensitive engagements with very high stakes and with visibility to leadership from day one. Throughout our process, you will have the opportunity to speak to one of the several team members who joined the Corporate Finance and Capital Advisory team via this channel, to understand how we support you in forging your career and tailor your learning to facilitate individualised progression.
Corporate Finance is a key part of our practice and provides a range of specialist services including business disposals, accelerated M&A, acquisition advisory, management buy outs, equity and debt fund raising and valuations. The Corporate Finance team plays a key role in the firm’s sector initiatives and has particular expertise in Consumer Products, Tourism, Hospitality & Leisure and Industrials. Working with the firm’s broader client base, the corporate finance team advises on projects across all industries. The team provides advice to a range of stakeholders including corporates, management teams, private equity and hedge fund investors and lenders.
This opportunity would suit an enthusiastic and committed individual who combines strong accounting and financial skills with sound commercial judgement. The ability to work effectively as part of a team, to deliver high quality written output to tight deadlines and to have the confidence to challenge views and make recommendations are key requisite skills.
Your day-to-day responsibilities will include:
- Taking an active role in the execution of transactions.
- Assisting in the conduct of valuations of businesses using a variety of valuation methodologies such as comparable companies’ analysis, comparable transactions analysis and discounted cash flow.
- Reviewing and critically analysing financial information or projections and testing their veracity.
- Producing financial models.
- Assisting in the preparation of marketing materials and other documentation including pitches, management presentations and client reports.
- Supporting sector initiatives and other business development opportunities through conducting research and analysis.
- Assisting in Corporate Finance development projects, such as internal training and internal and external presentations.

- ACA or ACCA qualified with first time passes.

- Previous Corporate Finance or due diligence experience is desirable but not essential.
- Possesses strong written and oral presentation skills, able to produce strong written outputs.
- Acquires and applies commercial and technical expertise.
- Able to work under pressure to meet challenging deadlines whilst being involved in a portfolio of projects.
- Demonstrates understanding of the importance of the risk management process.
- Focused on achieving success in individual and team projects and focused on self-development.
- Approachable and able to relate to people at all levels of the organisation.
- Is open-minded and agile with change.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
- Willingness to work outside of normal business hours, and in particular as unique projects/needs arise.

Alvarez & Marsal (A&M) is a global consulting firm with over 13,000 entrepreneurial, action and results-oriented professionals in over 40 countries. The Team
A&M’s Private Equity Performance Improvement Services (PEPI) practice, with offices throughout the US, focuses on serving the middle market and large cap private equity firms who have engaged A&M to help improve operating results at their portfolio companies.   
Our professionals are aligned with a PEPI service line to promote the development of deep functional skills & experiences and to maximize our ability to tailor solutions to solve our clients' business issues.

Supply Chain
Transformation Services
Manufacturing Operations Improvement
Interim Management
M&A Services
CFO Services

Gain a comprehensive understanding of a client’s procurement organization and strategic sourcing capabilities

We prioritize your well-being, providing benefits and resources to support you on your personal journey. Our people consistently highlight the growth opportunities, our unique, entrepreneurial culture, and the fun we have together as their favorite aspects of working at A&M. Additionally, employees are eligible for paid time off including vacation, personal days, seventy-two (72) hours of sick time (prorated for part time employees), ten federal holidays, one floating holiday, and parental leave. About Alvarez & Marsal
Alvarez & Marsal (A&M) is a global consulting firm with over 13,000 entrepreneurial, action and results-oriented professionals in over 40 countries. Operational Due Diligence
Synergy Assessment
Standalone Cost Assessment
Target Operating Model Development
Day 1 and 100 Milestone Planning
Transition Services Agreements (TSAs)
Performance Improvement
Project Management and Governance
Broaden your expertise, build your skillset
This is an opportunity to join the Professional Services sector team within A&M's PEPI practice and support private equity and corporate clients through complex transactions and transformations. Working across the full deal lifecycle, the team helps clients execute integrations, carve-outs, separations, and performance improvement programs that drive sustainable value creation and maximize investment outcomes.
The A&M team employs a structured, results-driven approach to help clients maximize transaction value across mergers, acquisitions, carve-outs, divestitures, joint ventures, and strategic alliances. Leveraging expertise in operational due diligence, Day 1 planning, integration management, synergy capture, carve-out analysis, standalone cost assessments, TSA development and governance, post-close execution, and performance improvement, the team helps clients mitigate risk, accelerate timelines, and realize the full value potential of their transactions.

4-6+ years of professional experience in management consulting, investment banking, private equity, corporate development, with a demonstrated track record of M&A ideally with experience within the Professional Services space. 
Experience in integration / separation planning and execution a plus, but not required

Description
Junior Consultants work at the forefront of environmental compliance, supporting key initiatives by ensuring that technical, environmental, or operational standards are met. Their main tasks involve validating and managing engineering, parametric and supplier-provided product environmental technical data and information.
Key responsibilities
Data Management
- Document material and substance content of parts and materials based on technical sources.
- Maintain and update project records and process documentation for workflows and tasks.
- Recommend and implement changes for continuous improvement.
- Collect, test (as needed), validate, and manage data related to product and environmental compliance, ensuring accuracy and completeness in all records. 
- Assist in reviewing and processing supplier-provided material composition content information, including lab reports, according to defined protocols. 
- Ensure all documentation meets compliance standards.
Supplier and Client Communications 
- Provide support and assistance to the suppliers in producing the required regulatory and compliance data. 
- Be involved in the exchange of information between the business and the clients, ensuring smooth operations and maintaining strong relationships. 
Progress Tracking and Reporting: 
- Track the progress and performance of compliance activities, prepare technical and other reports as requested to document progress and results achieved to provide insights and updates to stakeholders.
- Technical Data Utilization: Utilize product engineering, technical documents, or parametric data to meet various client and customer needs. Ensure data is correctly interpreted and applied to support compliance efforts. • Risk Assessment: Support senior engineers in assessing risks associated with material composition of parts and assemblies. Help document business processes for collecting and managing environmental, carbon, and sustainability-related supplier data.
Skills, knowledge and expertise
- Candidate must possess at least a Bachelor's/College Degree in Engineering (Chemical/Materials/Electrical/Electronics, Mechanical), Chemistry or equivalent experience (minimum 1 year) specializing in Engineering – Chemical/Materials/Electrical/Electronic
- Experience with Parametric Data, managing/ interpreting Technical Drawings/Datasheets 
- Knowledge in Product Compliance, Full Material Disclosure (FMD) Data, Material Safety Datasheet (MSDS) 
- 2+ years’ experience in environmental compliance or product sustainability, with direct experience in EPEAT certification 
- 2+ years’ experience in waste management regulations (e.g., WEEE, EPR) and sustainable packaging standards (e.g., FSC, compostable and recyclable materials) 
- Knowledge of electronics/electrical manufacturing, bills of materials (BoMs), and materials typically used in electrical/electronic manufacturing 
- Excellent communication skills, particularly in verbal and written English 
- Strong proficiency with digital software data handling tools (MS Office suite) 
- Experience in SAP-EHSM, CMAP, CDX, IMDS, Alteryx, PowerBI will be an advantage 
- Knowledge of foreign language (e.g. Chinese and/or Japanese) spoken and written technical language capability will be an advantage (required on certain projects)

jd_text:
Joining Arup
Arup’s purpose, shared values and collaborative approach has set us apart for over 80 years, guiding how we shape a better world.
The Opportunity 
The Sustainability team within Arup’s Property London division works with a range of property clients to develop and deliver sustainability and carbon strategies for property development and refurbishment projects, both independently and as part of multi-disciplinary Arup teams. Increasingly the brief for these developments includes an aspiration to achieve Net Zero Carbon, and so energy performance is a key focus.
We are seeking an energy modelling consultant to join the growing energy modelling group within the sustainability team. This group provides some oversight of general IES modelling for Part L compliance, but is primarily focused on advanced energy modelling, including for TM54, NABERS and LEED, as well as early stage parametric modelling using tools such as Grasshopper. In addition to delivering more advanced energy modelling, this core team is responsible for training and skills development for engineers working in these areas.
The successful candidate for this role will be responsible for delivery of advanced energy modelling across a number of projects, including both undertaking modelling directly and guiding graduates and apprentices in the development of IES models. We are able to support the successful candidate through their Chartership journey.
The role will include: 
· Undertaking advanced energy modelling including for TM54, NABERS and bespoke project requirements, using a combination of IES-VE, including APACHE HVAC, spreadsheets and other advanced analytics tools as needed.
· Oversee junior engineers/modellers in the delivery of advanced energy modelling.
· Engage with project mechanical designers to ensure the energy model is a close representation of the design, and that the modelling outcomes inform the design development.
· Review/assist junior engineers in the delivery of Part L energy /compliance models.
· Contribute to the development of training resources and the delivery of advanced energy modelling training for our engineers.
· Contribute to the delivery of research focused on improving the tools, techniques and approaches we employ for advanced energy modelling.
· The role will be based in Central London but may involve some travelling nationally and internationally.
At Arup, you belong to an extraordinary collective – in which we encourage individuality to thrive. Our strength comes from how we respect, share and connect our diverse experiences, perspectives and ideas.
You will have the opportunity do socially useful work that has meaning – to Arup, to your career, to our members and to the clients and communities we serve.
Is this role right for you?
· At least 2 years using IES VE with ApacheHVAC for advanced modelling (TM54 or NABERS or LEED) as a major part of current or previous role.
· Proven experience in undertaking a range of energy modelling activities or a range of project types such as energy performance modelling, compliance and thermal comfort analysis, including models for planning and as-built (Part L, EPCs), familiarity with Building Regulations Part L.
· Experience/awareness of TM54 / BREEAM Ene01 / NABERS UK and/or LEED.
· Experience in Data Analysis using Excel.
· Developing understanding of building HVAC systems and controls.
· Degree in an area such as; mechanical engineering, building services, architectural engineering, building physics.
· Working towards chartership with CIBSE, IMechE or other relevant Engineering Council body.
· Holds or interested to obtain qualifications as Low Carbon Consultant, Low Carbon Energy Assessor, Non-domestic Energy Assessor.
· Experience/ interest in SAP and domestic energy assessment is of interest.
· Participates in industry bodies/conferences related to energy modelling, building performance, Net Zero and other topics related to the sustainability of the built environment.
· Able to work autonomously, stay focused and with attention to detail.
· Experience of working in multi-disciplinary teams.
· Ability to work under pressure and meet strict deadlines.
· Excellent communication skills (both written and oral).
· Excellent planning, organisational and time management skills.
· Highly motivated and willing to take on new challenges.
The following skills are not essential but would be beneficial to the delivery of the role:
· Experience with another package such as DesignBuilder or EDSL TAS is a bonus.
· Experience in parametric energy and thermal modelling using Grasshopper, Ladybug and Honeybee.
· Coding experience (Python, Visual Basic etc.).
· Ability to work 3D/3D CAD software i.e. AutoCAD, Sketchup, Rhino and Revit etc.

Joining Arup
Arup’s purpose, shared values and collaborative approach have set us apart for 80 years, guiding how we shape a better world.
The water sector is undergoing unprecedented change. Climate risks, population growth, ageing infrastructure, environmental ambition and sector reform are creating some of the most complex challenges the industry has ever faced. Our clients are looking for new ways to plan, invest and adapt, and Arup is helping shape that future.
The Opportunity
We are looking for a junior consultant to join our dynamic and growing team, in one of our offices in Bristol, Cardiff and Birmingham, who is excited by the challenge of driving innovation, delivering excellence for our clients, influencing the sector both nationally and internationally through our projects and thought leadership, and working in collaborative, diverse teams. We combine policy, strategy, economics, engineering and asset management expertise to help clients make better long-term decisions. Our work influences national policy, investment decisions and operational strategies across the water sector.
The Mid-West Strategic Water Services team provides expertise in:
- Policy, regulation and governance;
- Strategy and planning, including long-term strategies, adaptive plans, water resources management plans (WRMP), drainage and wastewater management plans (DWMP) and flood risk management strategies;
- Asset management and investment planning
As part of our growing Strategic Water Services team, you will work with leading water companies, regulators, governments and investors to tackle nationally significant challenges and help create more resilient water systems for people and the environment.
You will help us to deliver effective and professional services for a range of varied and high-profile clients, such as Welsh Water, Wessex Water, Northern Ireland Water, Severn Trent Water, The Nature Conservancy, Ofwat, Natural Resources Wales and the Environment Agency. Working as part of a team, your role will be to advise city and infrastructure clients on a range of policy, regulatory, asset management and engineering issues. 
Across the public and private sectors, you will help manage client relationships with public sector agencies, private sector clients, infrastructure operators and other organisations such as regulators.
What you’ll do
Working collaboratively with colleagues across the UK and internationally, you will help deliver strategic advisory services for a range of clients in the water sector. You will contribute to research, analysis, client engagement and project delivery, helping to shape robust and forward-looking solutions.
Your responsibilities are likely to include:
- Shaping water sector strategy, policy and investment decisions.
- Supporting clients on climate resilience, water security and infrastructure challenges.
- Analysing data and evidence to develop strategic recommendations.
- Engaging water companies, regulators, governments and stakeholders.
- Collaborating with multidisciplinary teams to deliver integrated solutions.
- Supporting project delivery, business development and client relationships.
- Contributing to thought leadership and industry best practice.
- Developing expertise through training, mentoring and varied projects.

- Degree in Engineering, Economics, Geography, Environmental Science, Mathematics, Water Science, Public Policy, Asset Management or related field; Master's/PhD desirable. 
- Experience in water, regulation, engineering, asset management, investment planning, strategy or a related field. 
- Knowledge or strong interest in water regulation, business planning, price reviews, performance frameworks, asset management and investment planning. 
- Interest in climate resilience, environmental improvement, water security, affordability and long-term sustainability. 
- Understanding of, or willingness to learn, the water sector’s regulatory and policy environment. 
- Strong analytical, problem-solving and strategic thinking skills. 
- Excellent communication, stakeholder engagement and relationship-building skills. 
- Ability to work across engineering, economics, policy, regulation and sustainability, with curiosity, initiative and strong organisation.

jd_text:
Chez Capgemini Invent, nous croyons que l'innovation est le moteur du changement. En tant que consultants en transformation digitale, nous combinons nos capacités stratégiques, créatives et scientifiques, en collaborant étroitement avec nos clients pour leur fournir des solutions de pointes. Rejoignez-nous pour conduire une transformation adaptée aux défis d'aujourd'hui et de demain.
Lieu : Paris ou Toulouse
Vos missions
L’entité Aerospace & Defense accompagne les grands acteurs de l’aéronautique, du spatial et de la défense dans leurs projets de transformation digitale, durable et opérationnelle. Nos équipes interviennent sur des problématiques variées telles que le ramp-up industriel, la continuité numérique, la conformité règlementaire, l’optimisation de processus industriel, la sustainability.
En tant que consultant junior, vous accompagnerez les équipes sur des problématiques de stratégie, d’organisation et d’efficacité opérationnelle.
Vos responsabilités au sein d'une équipe projet et au contact du client seront :
- de collecter et d’analyser des données, via la conduite d’entretiens ou l’animation d’ateliers de co-construction chez le client,
- de participer à la présentation à nos clients des recommandations stratégiques identifiées avec eux,
- et de vous investir dans la vie interne du cabinet (recrutement, formations ; exemples : développement de contenu sectoriel et technologiques, développement personnel, prise de parole en public etc..).
Votre profil
- Diplômé d'école d’ingénieur, de commerce ou d’université, avec un vif intérêt pour les problématiques de transformation des entreprises et d’innovation digitale ; 
- Appétence particulière pour l’aéronautique, le spatial ou la défense ;
- Maîtrise courante de l’anglais et du français, à l’écrit comme à l’oral ; 
- Curiosité intellectuelle marquée et forte capacité d’adaptation dans des environnements variés.
Quelques raisons de nous rejoindre
- Avantages groupe : bénéficiez d’un ensemble d’avantages tels que les primes de cooptation, tickets restaurant, ainsi que des activités sociales et culturelles variées proposées par le CSE. Des dispositifs d’accompagnement à la parentalité, comme le temps partiel à 90% pendant les vacances scolaires, sont également disponibles, ainsi que de nombreux autres avantages issus de nos accords collectifs.
- Qualité de vie au travail : profitez d’un équilibre entre vie professionnelle et personnelle, d’une possibilité de télétravailler (en France), ainsi que des dispositifs de santé et bien-être (ligne d'écoute, plateforme dédiée...).
- Environnement inclusif : rejoignez des réseaux engagés comme Women@Capgemini, Parents@Capgemini, OUTfront ou CapAbility, et évoluez dans un cadre certifié EDGE+ et reconnu par le Bloomberg Gender Equality Index.
- Happy Trainees : notre engagement envers les jeunes talents est reconnu dans le classement HappyTrainees, preuve que chez nous, les stagiaires et alternants ne viennent pas juste apprendre… ils viennent s’épanouir !
Nos engagements et priorités
Le groupe Capgemini encourage une culture inclusive au sein d’un cadre multiculturel et handi-accueillant. En nous rejoignant, vous intégrez un collectif qui valorise la diversité, développe le potentiel de ses talents, s’engage dans des initiatives solidaires avec ses partenaires et se mobilise pour réduire son impact environnemental sur l’ensemble de ses sites ainsi qu’auprès de ses clients.
Capgemini Invent est la marque d’innovation digitale, de design et de transformation du groupe Capgemini. Etablie dans plus de 30 studios et plus de 60 dans le monde, elle compte une équipe de plus de 12 500 experts en stratégie, data scientists, concepteurs de produits et d’expériences ou encore experts en marques et en technologie qui développent de nouveaux services digitaux, produits, expériences et modèles d’affaire pour une croissance durable.

jd_text:
At Capgemini Invent, we believe difference drives change. As inventive transformation consultants, we blend our strategic, creative and scientific capabilities, collaborating closely with clients to deliver cutting-edge solutions. Join us to drive transformation tailored to our client's challenges of today and tomorrow. Informed and validated by science and data. Superpowered by creativity and design. All underpinned by technology created with purpose. 
Your role
As a Organizational Change Management (OCM) Senior Consultant you will lead change and adoption activities for global Microsoft 365 and Dynamics 365 transformation programs. You will manage a team of Change Management professionals, collaborate with senior stakeholders, and drive communication, training, and user readiness initiatives to ensure successful business adoption. Working closely with project teams and client leadership, you will help organizations navigate complex change, mitigate risks, and maximize the value of their technology investments. This role combines strategic leadership, people management, and hands-on delivery in a global environment. 
Your tasks
- Develop and execute Organizational Change Management strategies to support global Microsoft 365 and Dynamics 365 tenant consolidation and migration initiatives.
- Manage, mentor, and develop a team of Change Management Consultants, ensuring high-quality delivery, continuous development, and effective workload allocation.

jd_text:
At Capgemini Invent, we believe difference drives change. Join us to drive transformation tailored to our client’s challenges of today and tomorrow. Informed and validated by science and data. Superpowered by creativity and design. All underpinned by technology created with purpose.
About the Job You’re Considering
As AI reshapes how organizations operate, compete, and create value, we are evolving our consulting model to be AI-enabled by design, augmenting human judgment with analytics, automation, and generative AI. Our teams are looking for consultants who are not only strong problem solvers, but who are excited to work differently in an AI-first world: curious, adaptable, and ready to help clients reimagine how work gets done.
frog is the customer experience and design practice of Capgemini Invent and the reinvention and experience partner for the eco-digital era. We work at the intersection of business strategy, experience design, and applied technology, bringing together strategists, designers, engineers, and data scientists. We start with the customer and carry our ideas through to production.
Within frog’s Customer Transformation practice, we help clients reinvent how they serve their customers. Our work combines business strategy, service and experience design, data, technology, and AI to transform contact centers and customer service operations. We help clients determine what to automate, what to augment, and how to improve customer outcomes while reducing cost to serve.
Your Role
As a Consultant or Senior Consultant, Service & Contact Center Transformation, you will lead or support workstreams focused on transforming how organizations serve their customers across voice, digital, and assisted channels. You will use quantitative and qualitative analysis to identify the drivers of customer demand, evaluate operational performance, and build the case for service transformation.
Working alongside practice leaders and multidisciplinary teams, you will contribute from current-state diagnostic and experience design through solution development, implementation, adoption, and value realization. You will collaborate with client stakeholders, designers, technology specialists, and operational leaders to develop practical recommendations that improve customer experience, frontline effectiveness, and contact center economics.
Key responsibilities include:
- Lead or support workstreams within contact center and customer service transformation engagements, from current-state assessment and discovery through solution design, production, adoption, and value realization.
- Conduct client and customer interviews, journey mapping, call-driver and intent analysis, operational benchmarking, and cost-to-serve modeling to identify the root causes of contact demand and performance challenges.
- Develop current-state assessments, journey maps, service blueprints, operating model options, transformation roadmaps, financial models, and business cases that translate analysis into clear recommendations.
- Support the design of AI-enabled service solutions incorporating voice AI agents, agent assist, next best action, intelligent routing, knowledge management, digital self-service, real-time monitoring, and effective human handoffs.
- Facilitate client workshops and working sessions, support proposals and oral presentations, contribute to change management and adoption, and help develop points of view, reusable assets, and junior team members.
Your Skills + Experience
You bring strong AI literacy, including core AI and generative AI concepts, and collaborate effectively across strategy, technology, data, and design to enable AI-driven solutions, with a solid understanding of responsible AI principles such as ethics, privacy, security, and governance. You demonstrate curiosity and a continuous learning mindset around emerging AI capabilities and their practical application in client environments.
You are skilled at structuring complex business problems, finding insights in qualitative and quantitative data, and building a compelling case for change. You understand how service strategy, experience design, operations, data, and technology come together to shape customer and frontline experiences.
You can engage in discussions about how telephony, routing, IVR, Contact Center as a Service, CRM, agent desktops, knowledge management, workforce management, quality management, and analytics operate as an integrated ecosystem. You bring deeper expertise in at least one area and have the curiosity and aptitude to build broader platform knowledge.
You understand the operational and financial measures that underpin service transformation, including containment, average handle time, first-contact resolution, transfer rate, customer satisfaction, and cost per contact. You can use these measures to establish performance baselines, evaluate opportunities, and support a credible business case.
Required Experience:
- Three or more years of relevant experience in management consulting, digital services, contact center operations, or customer service transformation. Candidates with five or more years of relevant experience may be considered for the Senior Consultant level.
- Functional depth in at least two areas such as customer service transformation, service experience design, contact forecasting and workforce management, quality management, IVR and routing design, conversational AI, speech analytics, performance measurement and KPIs, or omnichannel engagement.
- Strong analytical capabilities, including experience working with customer interaction data, call drivers, intent analysis, operational benchmarks, financial models, and contact center performance measures.
- Ability to collaborate across business strategy, experience design, operations, data, and technology; facilitate client workshops; synthesize findings; and communicate clear recommendations to client and project stakeholders.
- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience, with the ability to travel up to 50% on average based on project and client needs.
Preferred Experience:

summary:

Du kommer att spela en central roll i att stödja det svenska försvarets pågående förmågetillväxt genom strategisk rådgivning, transformation och innovation.

jd_text:
Om rollen
Rollen är en unik möjlighet att leda och vidareutveckla Capgemini Invents försvarsaffär i Sverige, med särskilt fokus på Försvarsmakten, FMV och andra försvarsmyndigheter. Du kommer att spela en central roll i att stödja det svenska försvarets pågående förmågetillväxt genom strategisk rådgivning, transformation och innovation. Du blir en central partner till våra kunder inom försvarssektorn och driver kritiska initiativ som bidrar till att stärka svensk försvarsförmåga. Uppdraget innebär att du sätter dig in i kundernas verksamhet och behov, identifierar möjligheter och utformar lösningar med stöd av Capgemini Groups starka globala kapacitet inom rådgivning, försvarskunnande, teknologi, data och AI. Du har ett övergripande ansvar utveckla kundrelationen, identifiera nya affärsmöjligheter och säkerställa långsiktigt och lönsamt samarbete med våra nyckelkunder inom försvarssegmentet. Genom att stärka partnerskapen och skapa tydliga, mätbara resultat bidrar du direkt till våra kunders framgång och till ett starkare och säkrare Sverige. Detta är ett av våra mest prioriterade områden och rollen har därför hög synlighet och stor strategisk betydelse.
Huvudsakliga ansvarsområden
- Bygga och utveckla strategiska kundrelationer inom försvarssektorn.
- Fördjupa dig i försvarsmyndigheternas uppdrag, förutsättningar och behov samt förstå hur Capgemini Invent bäst kan bidra till att skapa verklig effekt och stärkt svensk försvarsförmåga.
- Fungera som betrodd rådgivare till tjänstemän, chefer och ledande beslutsfattare samt utmana och vägleda deras strategiska riktning.
- Driva kommersiell tillväxt och utveckla försvarssegmentet långsiktigt.
- Leda affärsutveckling, från att identifiera nya möjligheter till att forma erbjudanden och vinna strategiska uppdrag.
- Expandera och utveckla försvarskonton samt bygga långsiktiga partnerskap med fokus på konkreta och mätbara resultat.
- Designa och leda transformationsprogram inom områden som verksamhetsutveckling, digitalisering, data och analys, AI samt större förmågehöjande initiativ.
- Samarbeta med tvärfunktionella experter och leveransteam inom Capgemini Group för att erbjuda integrerade och innovativa lösningar.
- Bidra till, samarbeta med och dra nytta av Capgeminis internationella försvarsexpertis genom Defense Europe.
- Bidra till att forma framtidens försvarsförmåga genom att driva dialogen kring områden som digital suveränitet, AI, cyberförsvar, interoperabilitet, data och försörjningsberedskap.
- Representera Capgemini Invent i försvars- och myndighetsekosystemet genom ledningsdialoger, konferenser, seminarier och branschforum.
- Leda, coacha och utveckla konsulter på alla nivåer.
- Främja en inkluderande, samarbetsinriktad och innovativ kultur inom Capgemini Invent.
Din profil
Du är en erfaren ledare med stark bakgrund inom offentlig sektor, försvarssektorn eller närliggande områden samt lång erfarenhet av konsultverksamhet och komplexa transformationer. Vi söker dig som har:
- Omfattande erfarenhet från statlig verksamhet eller försvarsrelaterade organisationer med god förståelse för styrning, regelverk, ekonomistyrning och beslutsprocesser.
- Stark kommersiell drivkraft och dokumenterat resultat inom affärsutveckling, kundansvar och långsiktig tillväxt.
- Etablerat nätverk och dokumenterad erfarenhet av att navigera komplexa beslutsmiljöer inom försvars- eller statlig sektor.
- Tryggt ledarskap och mycket god kommunikationsförmåga, med förmåga att påverka och bygga förtroende på högsta nivå.
- Dokumenterad erfarenhet av att leda komplexa transformationsprogram, exempelvis inom digitalisering, datadriven verksamhetsutveckling, organisationsförändring eller större strategiska initiativ.
- Akademisk examen inom exempelvis ekonomi, statsvetenskap, samhällsvetenskap, teknik eller motsvarande. Officersutbildning eller erfarenhet från Försvarsmakten, FMV eller annan försvarsrelaterad verksamhet är också meriterande.
- Flytande svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift.
- För rollen krävs svenskt medborgarskap och möjlighet att genomgå samt godkännas i säkerhetsprövning enligt säkerhetsskyddslagen.
Varför Capgemini Invent
Att bli en del av Capgemini Invent innebär att ansluta till en global gemenskap av innovatörer, strateger, teknologer och förändringsledare som formar framtidens samhälle. Vi erbjuder:
- Meningsfull påverkan: Leda transformationer för några av Sveriges viktigaste myndigheter och bidra till att stärka svensk försvarsförmåga.
- Innovation i stor skala: Arbeta med spjutspetskompetens inom AI, data, cybersäkerhet, digital suveränitet och framtidens försvarsförmågor.
- Karriärutveckling: Tillgång till världsledande utbildningar, ledarskapsprogram, mentorskap och globala karriärmöjligheter.
- En samarbetsdriven kultur: Arbeta tillsammans med några av marknadens främsta experter i en kultur som värdesätter samarbete, entreprenörskap och kontinuerligt lärande.
- Global räckvidd, lokal påverkan: Kombinera styrkan från ett globalt nätverk med möjligheten att göra verklig skillnad för svenska kunder och samhället i stort.
Ansökan
I linje med vår tillitsbaserade kultur erbjuder Capgemini Invent ett flexibelt arbetssätt. Rollen är baserad på vårt centralt belägna kontor i Stockholm, med resor till kund vid behov.
Befattning och ansvarsnivå baseras på en helhetsbedömning av din erfarenhet och kompetens.
Som en del av vår rekryteringsprocess kommer identitetskontroll att genomföras genom granskning av giltig ID-handling, och bakgrundskontroller kan komma att genomföras där så är relevant.
Om Capgemini 
Capgemini är en global partner inom affärs- och tekniktransformation som hjälper organisationer att påskynda övergången till en digital och hållbar värld, och samtidigt gör skillnad för företag och samhälle. Det är en ansvarsfull och mångsidig organisation med 423 400 medarbetare i över 50 länder. Med ett starkt arv som sträcker sig över 55 år tillbaka har Capgemini sina kunders förtroende att hjälpa dem frigöra värdet av teknik för att tillgodose hela deras affärsbehov. Capgemini levererar helhetslösningar som utnyttjar styrkan från strategi och design till teknik. Allt drivet av en marknadsledande kapacitet inom AI, generativ AI, moln och data, kombinerat med en djup branschexpertis och ett ekosystem av partners. År 2025 rapporterade Capgemini Group globala intäkter på 22,5 miljarder euro.

jd_text:
Présentation
Chez Capgemini Invent, nous croyons que l’innovation est le moteur du changement. En tant que consultants en transformation digitale et organisation, nous combinons nos capacités stratégiques, créatives et scientifiques, en collaborant étroitement avec nos clients pour leur fournir des solutions de pointe. Rejoignez-nous pour conduire une transformation adaptée aux défis d'aujourd'hui et de demain.
Vos missions
Intégrez notre équipe Aerospace & Défense, à Toulouse, pour participer à des projets de la transformation numérique de bout-en-bout, de la définition de la stratégie jusqu’à la mise en œuvre dans les opérations, avec la data comme réacteur et une démarche de co-construction permanente orientée résultats, principalement dans le domaine de l’engineering et des opérations.
La transformation numérique n’est pas un événement ponctuel, il s’agit d’un processus continu. Nous développons des piliers clés pour soutenir nos clients au sein de l’industrie de l’aéronautique, du spatial et de la défense à chaque étape, notamment sur le plan de la continuité numérique pour la gestion du cycle de vie des produits (PLM), l’adoption de jumeaux numériques, l’optimisation de la main-d’œuvre et des processus, les usines logicielles et les modèles zéro émission nette.
Vous accompagnez les clients dans l’activation de l’ensemble des leviers à leur disposition pour améliorer leur compétitivité :
- Redéfinition des modèles opérationnels de l’ingénierie
- Optimisation de la performance des processus et activités d’ingénierie-
- Amélioration de la compétitivité du coût produit
- Implémentation de la continuité numérique sur le cycle de vie d’un produit
Quelques exemples de missions
- Ascendance Flight Technologies, faire de l’aviation décarbonée une réalité : rendre le pilotage d’un avion hybride le plus simple possible à utiliser pour que le pilote d’avion traditionnel ne soit pas dépaysé.
- Opérations nouvelle génération : contribuer à la transformation en participant à des programmes d’avions verts, des opérations axées sur les données et des systèmes autonomes. Aider à améliorer les opérations grâce à la production basée sur des données et des modèles, ainsi qu’à des services futurs tels que la mobilité urbaine, les dispositifs de surveillance des émissions de CO2 pour les compagnies aériennes et l’optimisation des opérations de démantèlement.
Votre profil
- Diplôme en Commerce, Ingénierie, ou Université avec intérêt pour transformation d'entreprise et innovation digitale.
- Expérience en conseil ou rôles opérationnels dans de grands groupes - à partir de 3-5 ans pour un rôle de Senior Consultant, à partir de 5 à 7 ans pour un rôle de Managing Consultant.
- Forte expertise sectorielle et connaissance des problématiques technologiques dans l’aéronautique, le spatial, la défense ou la construction navale.
- Expérience de pilotage des projets de transformation digitale dans les métiers de l’ingénierie et des organisations R&D.
- Français et anglais courant, mobile, curieux, et adaptable.
3 raisons de nous rejoindre
Qualité de vie au travail : accord de télétravail en France et à l’international, accord sur l’égalité professionnelle, la parentalité, l’équilibre des temps et la mobilité durable.
Apprentissage en continu : certifications et formations en libre accès, accompagnement sur mesure avec votre career manager, parcours d’intégration sur plusieurs mois.
Avantages groupe & CSE : plan actionnariat, tarifs préférentiels, remboursement partiel vacances, remboursement de votre abonnement sportif ou culturel
Nos engagements et priorités
Le groupe Capgemini encourage une culture inclusive dans un cadre multiculturel et handi-accueillant. En nous rejoignant, vous intégrez un collectif qui valorise la diversité, développe le potentiel de ses talents, s’engage dans des initiatives solidaires avec ses partenaires, et se mobilise pour réduire son impact environnemental sur tous ses sites et auprès de ses clients.

jd_text:
About the role:
The Energy Transition team’s purpose is to enable the development of an affordable, secure consumer centric, flexible and decarbonised global energy system. The team do this through taking a whole system thinking approach underpinned by innovation, impartiality, and robust evidence generation. We are focused on three key topics within the Energy Transition agenda: coal transition, grid development and renewable integration. 
The successful candidate will support our growth through developing new business and delivering energy transition projects that will deliver high quality and high impact advice to our Southeast Asia clients.
The ideal candidate is a passionate and motivated individual with energy market experience and business development and consulting skills. You will have a grasp of various electricity policies, market arrangements and regulatory frameworks and how these may evolve in the Southeast Asian region.
About us:
The Carbon Trust are global climate transition experts who deliver effective sector-wide and cross-sector solutions for our partners and the systems they operate to accelerate the transition towards a prosperous, resilient, low carbon future. For over 25 years we have joined the dots within sectors working alongside businesses, governments, public sector bodies, financial institutions and philanthropies, and across sectors from ICT, agriculture, food and drink to mining and metals, pharmaceuticals and chemicals, energy and offshore renewables around the world.
Main duties and responsibilities:
As the successful candidate you will drive business development by proactively pursuing sales opportunities and responding to competitive tenders, including writing bids and proposals. You will develop and strengthen relationships with key clients in the low carbon energy sector, attend conferences and external meetings, and build connections with key stakeholders.
You will also work on client projects of varying complexity from inception through to completion. This includes problem-solving, managing analysis, research and quality assurance, working as part of project teams and the QA of subcontractors, and liaising with client contacts on day-to-day project matters.
You will maintain and grow a network of stakeholders, clients and partners across the low carbon energy sector, helping the Southeast Asia team meet its targets for revenue and business development activity in the Energy Transition sector by achieving your own targets. 
Your success will be reflected in positive client feedback, leading to greater and more favourable Carbon Trust brand recognition, particularly in its target client markets.
Key skills we are looking for:
Strong business development skills, the ability to build client and partner relationships and influence stakeholders and a proven ability in developing successful bids in the low carbon energy sector across a range of private and/or public sector clients in Southeast Asia
The ability to work effectively in a matrix team environment and to take initiative and deliver projects independently when required
Excellent project management and project delivery skills and proficiency with MS Excel, MS Word and MS PowerPoint
Fluent English speaker (C1/C2 ideally) as well as excellent communication skills (written and oral) and the ability to lead and run workshop sessions, present to small and large audiences and write high quality reports.
Qualifications and experience: 
Degree educated (or equivalent) 
Experience of working within one or more markets in Southeast Asia, ideally Malaysia, Philippines, Vietnam or Indonesia.  
Experience of working within energy transition and within technical sales
Experience in system modelling/whole system analysis is desirable
Experience of designing or delivering innovation projects and programmes is desirable
Salary & Benefits: 
We offer a competitive salary and a performance-based bonus. Our hours are 37.5 per week with 17 days paid annual leave rising to 18 after 1 full years’ service plus bank holidays and a generous pension scheme.
This role is based from our Singapore office, and at the Carbon Trust we offer flexible working, offering our employees the opportunity to work from home up to 3 days per week. 
Joining the Carbon Trust offers the opportunity to work alongside leading experts in the low-carbon field, contributing to innovative solutions for a more sustainable future. To apply, please visit our application page and submit your CV and cover letter.
We believe that when people feel respected and included, they can truly flourish. We’re committed to advancing equal opportunities and we’re dedicated to building a multifaceted, equitable and inclusive culture. If you don’t meet all the requirements but you have the skills and the experience, we would encourage you to apply and tell us why you are the right person for the job.
The application deadline is Sunday 16th August,  however, we may close the position early if we receive a high volume of applications. We encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Due to our hybrid and flexible working policies, some interviews and onboarding processes may be conducted via video conferencing.
At the Carbon Trust, we are guided by our core values: integrity, ambition, collaboration, and excellence.

Why This Role Matter:
Driving Asia Pacific’s Net Zero Transformation
As Asia Pacific accelerates its energy transition, this role is pivotal in shaping strategies that turn climate ambition into action. ERM’s Sustainability & Climate Change team partners with leading organizations to design practical, defensible pathways to net zero, integrating ESG, circular economy, and portfolio innovation. Your expertise will help businesses reimagine models, enhance operational performance, and create long-term value without compromising commercial goals. With ERM scaling its impact regionally, this is your opportunity to influence decision-makers and shape a future where sustainability drives growth and resilience.
Key Responsibility:
- Climate strategy project development and implementation including low carbon economy transitions, GHG emissions reduction actions and plans, climate and net zero strategies, Science-Based Targets (SBT), climate-related financial risks and opportunity assessment, scenario analysis, mitigation and adaptation strategies, carbon credit project, etc.

- GHG WRI/IPCC Protocol and Guidance, Life Cycle Analysis (LCA), Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR)/sustainability reporting utilizing Global Reporting Initiative (GRI) Standards, SET reporting guidelines, SDG and other industry-specific tools.
- Support in response to sustainability indices, such as S&P Corporate Sustainability Assessment (S&P CSA), CDP, FTSE Russell, etc.
- Development of corporate sustainability reports and others in both Thai and English, including writing, editing and proofreading content.
- Support to assess business programs for social needs by measuring and valuing business broader societal impacts using concepts such as Social / Environmental Return on Investment, Natural Capital Protocol, Creating Shared Value, etc.
- Utilize AI-enabled tools to enhance project efficiency, research, report development, and knowledge management, ensuring accuracy, confidentiality, and compliance with ERM's quality standards.
Qualifications:
